_comment: Sandbox only (SANDBOX_MODE=true). Copy to config/sandbox.allowlist.json and replace the placeholders with your testers' own email and mobile. Calls/WhatsApp (and any future email) go ONLY to these users. Events from these emails, and from testEmailDomains, are kept as-is; everyone else is anonymised on arrival. Changes are picked up automatically, no restart needed. The XXXXX placeholders are deliberately invalid, so a copied-but-unedited file contacts nobody.
